name: Easy Carousel
description: Build carousels/sliders from reusable Carousel and Carousel Slide content entities, rendered by four configurable block types.
project_description: Easy Carousel provides an editor-friendly way to build image/media/text carousels in Drupal 11. It ships two custom content entity types — Carousel (an ordered collection) and Carousel Slide (carousel_item, an individual slide) — that editors manage under Content. Each slide can carry a referenced Media item (image, uploaded video, or remote oEmbed video), a base64-encoded inline image, or an external image URL, plus a title, rich-text description, link, per-slide background/title/description colors, opacity, and text alignment/position. A Carousel references any number of slides. The carousel is placed on the site by adding one of four block plugins — Simple, Bootstrap, Brands (infinite marquee), or Gallery — selecting a Carousel entity and configuring per-block options (controls, indicators, autoplay, speed, height, slide width, margins). Rendering is done by dedicated Twig templates and vanilla-JS libraries bundled locally with the module (a customized Bootstrap 5 build for the Bootstrap type). An admin Export/Import pair serializes all carousels and slides to a ZIP for backup/migration (import destructively deletes existing carousels/slides first).
